system.title: System
about: The operating layer of HIVE — how models are chosen, how work is measured, and how plan → build → mark stays honest.
Open this hex to step into a nested comb with five chambers: Benchmarks, Docs, Env, Skills, and Workflows.
system.focus: Keep routing cheap, verifiers loud, and handovers exhaustive.

benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.tagline: AI-Benchmark — model traits and cost signals
about: Where model behaviour, latency, and routing evidence live.
Used to tune which hive-* specialist owns plan, build, mark, vision, and research — not a dump of test harness code.
benchmarks.focus: Watch burn vs quality; propose routing tweaks from multi-day trends.

skills.title: Skills
about: Reusable procedures the parent agent loads on demand — digital-brain, video-vision, anti-slop, fable-mode, model-routing, execution-guardrails.
Open the Skills hex in the System comb to browse the live catalog pulled from /api/system-catalog.
skills.focus: Assess every task: thinking → planner/architect; building → builder ladder; day-to-day → lesser models.

workflows.title: Workflows
about: The fixed HIVE pipeline: user goal → hive-planner → hive-builder → hive-marker → launch.
Handovers live in Hand-Over central; mark notes in Requires review. Sector refreshes truth from disk — never from session memory alone.
workflows.focus: Two-pass gate: mark does not fix what it reviews. Gaps become ❓ notes, not guesses.

football.title: Football
football.tagline: Ethekwini City FC · Manning Rangers Sporting
about: Club documents for both sides of the name/league swap — player and coach agreements, SAFA letter, equipment quote, clearances, badges, trials flyer.
Everything is local under Football/ and reachable from the Comb vault.
football.focus: Contracts, SAFA placement letter, and Charmers equipment quote are ready for human fill-in and sign-off.

eta-work.title: ETA Work
about: etaConnect monitoring, assessment pipeline, study guides, and assignment drafts for BMSR modules.
Drafts are labelled by provenance — official LMS, HIVE evidence, assistant, or needs your confirm — never silently invented.
eta-work.focus: BMSR114 test prep and BMSR120 assignment drafts surface from Comb assignment hexes and the vault.

digital-brain.title: Digital Brain
digital-brain.tagline: Living Obsidian vault — state, entities, reports
about: Canonical memory for projects, people, and decisions. Agents read _STATE and entity notes before inventing facts.
Pack-it-up and Video-Inbox reviews write into reports/ and re-verify the vault.
digital-brain.focus: Keep _STATE fresh after sector; don’t answer pipeline questions from chat memory alone.

stella.title: Stella
about: Stella Indoor is the product surface; Stella@Glenwood is the site/webapp lane.
Both live under HIVE folders and share the Comb as the OS entry point.
stella.focus: Treat production src/ changes as live; verify against deployed reality when tests disagree.

praeto.title: Praeto
about: Praeto commercial and product work — Compliance Club history, Balance app, Office AI Portal, and the Million dollar 90-day plan lane.
One hex here so the deep comb stays readable; open chips for the folder you need.
praeto.focus: Balance migrate/seed and Office Portal stay separate codebases — pick the chip, don’t mix vault roots.

hermes.title: Hermes
about: Hermes-Bridge carries short intents from your phone into the HIVE inbox and notifies when work completes.
Courier only — it does not replace sector or the Comb OS.
hermes.focus: Check hermes on wake; notify on completion without leaving stray browser tabs.

video-inbox.title: Video-Inbox
about: Drop zone for WhatsApp reels and local videos. Sector runs video-vision / hive-video to extract frames, optional transcript, and a dated review.
Manifest + Digital Brain keep what you’ve already watched.
video-inbox.focus: Unviewed count shows on the Comb surface badge when present.

personal.title: Personal
about: Personal documents and side projects that stay off the commercial Praeto and ETA tracks.
Still reachable from the Comb OS when you dive in.
personal.focus: Keep secrets out of commits; Comb never invents missing files.

projects.title: Projects
projects.tagline: Everything else in the outer ring
about: Smaller or quieter HIVE folders grouped so the main deep comb stays like the homepage — dense, centered, readable.
Open this hex for Anialah, Project Tech, Tiespro, Boss questionnaire, Backend Checklist, Notion-Access, council-reports, fable-mode, and kin.
projects.focus: Use the nested comb; each sub-hex still opens its own topic card.

anialah.title: Anialah
about: HIVE folder for Anialah work — open the vault when you need files, not a code tour.

project-tech.title: Project Tech
about: Scratch and tooling space under Project Tech.

tiespro.title: Tiespro
about: Tiespro project work living under HIVE.

boss-questionnaire.title: Boss Questionnaire
about: Questionnaire build and deploy URL for boss-facing intake — keep the Comb link handy when sharing.

backend-checklist.title: Backend Checklist
about: Checklist and backend hygiene notes for shipping safely.

notion-access.title: Notion Access
about: Tokens, sharing, and access notes for Notion-backed HIVE surfaces. Comb itself is local-first now.

council-reports.title: Council reports
about: Stored council-style reports separate from Digital Brain entity notes.

fable-mode.title: Fable mode
about: fable-mode skills enforce stage plans, verification gates, and skeptical self-review on large work.

comb.title: The Comb
about: The Comb is the HIVE operating surface: surface rails, deep hive, ETA drafts, vault mounts.
You are looking at it now.
comb.focus: Hard-refresh after SW bumps so shell caches don’t stick.
